title: Town Wall

steps.prompt: One straight section of a town wall: a low thick wall of pale stone blocks with a walkway of heavy planks on top and a row of chunky pointed wooden stakes along the outer edge, seen from the front, long and low, solid simple shapes, no thin parts, nothing around it. A single object alone, centred, whole object in frame with margin, three-quarter view from slightly above, plain flat white background, even shadowless lighting, no ground, no hands, no extra objects. High-end anime fantasy RPG prop art, stylised 3D look with painterly textures, soft cel shading with warm bounce light and cool rim light, carefully designed surface detail, lush bright colours with luminous highlights, only the object described and nothing else on it, original design, no characters, no faces, no photorealism, no text, no watermark, no logo.

steps.version: trellis_2_bf16 with shape and texture VAEs and dino_v3_vit_l (Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2), BiRefNet background removal inside the workflow, ComfyUI 0.39.0 built-in nodes

cleanup: Automatic only, by tools/pipeline/blender_finish_model.py: stood upright, welded, decimated to 6000 triangles, smart UV unwrap, vertex colours baked to a 2048 px texture, scaled so the longest side is 8 m, origin at the centre of the base.
notes: Input image: stylekit/golden/f1/con_env_palisade_wall.png. The concept image went through TRELLIS.2 (BiRefNet cut-out, shape, texture, remesh, reduce to about 40,000 triangles, unwrap, bake), then Blender reduced it to the budget and re-baked the texture. Measured: source_tris=5976 final_tris=5976 dims=8.000x1.678x2.294 tex=2048. Made for Huskhaven as a small town (decision 0016). Judged from a rendered preview only; not yet seen in the headset.
